run_eval_stsp_cli: run the eval_stsp CLI to evaluate sentiment predictions against a gold reference JSONL file
run_eval_stsp_emotion: run the eval_stsp CLI with label emotion to evaluate emotion predictions against gold records
eval_function_accuracy: run the eval function to compute accuracy between predictions and gold records for sentiment or emotion labels
eval_function_dict_predictions: run the eval function with a predictions dictionary instead of a file path to compute accuracy
load_pred_jsonl: run the load_pred function to load predictions from a JSONL file into a dictionary keyed by id
